copy.tagline_en: Add graceful degradation with helpful messages to your system

howto.what: 当某个可选服务不可用时，Claude 不会静默失败，而是给出清晰的提示：说明哪个服务缺失、哪些功能降级，以及如何启用该服务，然后继续提供剩余功能。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要调用一个可选的外部服务（如本地 AI 模型服务器）但该服务未运行或不可达时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 LMStudio 是否在运行？
如果 LMStudio 没开，请告诉我怎么启动。
say.note: Claude 会返回降级消息，包含启用服务的具体步骤。

howto.what_en: When an optional service is unavailable, Claude does not fail silently. Instead, it provides a clear message explaining which service is missing, which features are degraded, and how to enable the service, then continues with reduced functionality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to call an optional external service (e.g., a local AI model server) but the service is not running or unreachable.

say_en.text: If LMStudio is not running, tell me how to start it.
say_en.note: Claude returns a fallback message with specific steps to enable the service.
